subject: Publicity & logo use - MSA / Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hanson Legal <contracts@hansonlp.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Publicity & logo use — MSA redlines

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team reviewed the MSA you shared (MSA_v3) and attached a redline focusing on publicity and reference rights. High-level asks:
- We need an embargo option for any joint press release tied to our upcoming clinical announcement.
- Logo/brand use should be limited to co-branded marketing only with prior written approval.
- No automatic customer reference rights for case studies without an additional written consent clause.

I've attached our redline: MSA_v3_CSH_redlines.docx. Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept narrow publicity language or if you need a broader customer reference right in the MSA/Order Form?

Also looping in Hanson Legal for any specific trademark guidance.

Thanks,

Jordan Price
Head of Partnerships, ClearSky Health
jordan.price@clearskyhealth.com
Attachments: MSA_v3_CSH_redlines.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hanson Legal <contracts@hansonlp.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publicity & logo use — MSA redlines

Jordan — thanks for the redline and the clear summary. Appreciate the embargo ask; that’s reasonable given your product timing. A few quick notes from my side (high level):

- Redwood typically asks for a limited customer reference right in the MSA so we can list the customer name/company as a customer and include a short (1-paragraph) case study with prior approval. We can narrow approval windows (e.g., 5 business days).
- Logo use: we can accept low-res logo use on our customer page and in sales decks provided you retain trademark control and brand guidelines apply. Co-marketing (joint webinars/press) would require separate marketing approval.
- Embargos: we can include an embargo carve-out in publicity clause tied to your clinical announcement date.

I'm attaching a short suggested clause snippet for consideration (publicity_snippet_for_CSH.txt). Can you confirm which logos (primary, product) you want permitted and whether your legal needs trademark sign-off language?

I'll loop in Legal for a formal redline but wanted to get alignment on scope before we trade more redlines.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: publicity_snippet_for_CSH.txt

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publicity & logo use — MSA redlines

Kim / Jordan — quick sales perspective:
- We should be flexible but pragmatic. Offer: allow Redwood to use "ClearSky Health" as a customer name and a one-paragraph quoted blurb after approval.
- Logo: limit to low-res display and product-compatibility badges on our site. Any marketing campaigns or press/PR require written approval and a 5-business-day review turnaround.
- Co-marketing requires a separate SOW or addendum.

If Legal narrows the approval timeline in writing we can mark this as green for the deal. Happy to take offline with procurement if you prefer.

Karthik
Head of Sales, East Region | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@clearskyhealth.com>, Hanson Legal <contracts@hansonlp.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publicity & logo use — MSA redlines

Kimberly,

Thanks — attached is a short PDF with our proposed alternative language (CSH_redline_publicity.pdf). Key points from our side:
- We can allow Redwood to identify ClearSky Health as a customer for marketing materials, but only as "ClearSky Health, a user of Redwood Inference" — we do not want extended case study permissions without separate written consent.
- Logo use is permitted only for use on vendor customer pages and in sales collateral with trademark usage subject to our brand guidelines (we include a link to the trademark rules in the PDF).
- We need an explicit embargo clause: Redwood may not issue any public statement about the relationship until 10 business days after our internal clinical results announcement or until we provide written clearance.

Two questions for Redwood: 1) Will you accept a 10-business-day embargo? 2) Can Redwood commit to removing any customer logos on request within 5 business days?

Appreciate the collaborative tone. If Redwood can accept the above, we can proceed with E-signature on the Order Form.

Best,
Elena Morales
General Counsel (interim), ClearSky Health
elena@clearskyhealth.com
Attachments: CSH_redline_publicity.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@clearskyhealth.com>, Elena Morales <elena@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hanson Legal <contracts@hansonlp.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T14:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publicity & logo use — MSA redlines (next steps)

Team — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Summary of the agreed approach so we can get procurement moving: 

1) Customer reference: Redwood may list ClearSky Health as a customer and publish a one-paragraph approved quote / short case blurb. Approval turnaround: 5 business days.
2) Logo use: ClearSky retains trademark control. Redwood permitted to use low-res logo on customer page and sales collateral. Redwood will remove logos within 5 business days of written request.
3) Embargo: Redwood agrees to a 10-business-day embargo tied to your clinical announcement or until you provide written clearance. Redwood will not issue press related to the relationship during embargo.
4) Co-marketing: separate addendum required for joint press, webinars, or paid campaigns.

Next steps: Redwood Legal will incorporate the language above into a short Order Form addendum and circulate a final redline by EOD 2027-08-20. Jordan — once you confirm the exact logo files (primary + product badge) we’ll prepare the trademark appendix. Marissa (cc'd) will follow up on a lightweight mutual reference addendum template for marketing.

DocuSign (order form) and HubSpot: I’ve linked the Order Form for signatures and the HubSpot deal in the related links. Please confirm and we’ll route to procurement.

Thanks all — appreciate the collaboration.

Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: OrderForm_Q3_Clearsky.xlsx
